files.description: Full post-repair Controller test suite run on the frozen candidate: 28 tests, OK, exit code 0, including the BASE_SEMANTICS_SUMMARY line emitted by the two-round end-to-end test

Round-1/Round-2 base semantics observed by the passing end-to-end fixture of the same run: execution base, control READY sha, Round-1 before_head and candidate, Round-2 before_head and candidate, and the related assertion flags

The same post-repair test file executed against the pre-repair controller source (git show dbecc71898131cc6545bf314dc2f7ba56d1df337:.agent/controller/controller.py); 13 of 28 tests fail, so the new execution-base assertions are not vacuous

Single-round controller run against a fixture whose control READY sha differs from the execution base, printing the published process.json and provenance.json verbatim so a reviewer can see the new base field in both records
Python source of the evidence-shape probe that produced base_probe.log (runs entirely inside a temporary directory; Python is named .txt because the bundle allows only text extensions)
